cues: Reflective strips on the pedals and wheels make evening trips more visible to passing motorists.
An inner tube holds pressurized air, and a small valve lets a floor pump refill it.
Bright front and rear lamps attach to the frame for commuting after sunset.
Many city models use a low step-through frame, making mounting easier in ordinary clothes.
Aluminum tubing keeps the structure light enough to carry up apartment stairs.
A U-shaped lock threads through the frame and a street rack to deter theft outside shops.
